script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let lastAbility be the last move of executer.
If lastAbility, then
  Let v be if the value "castTimeAbilityId" of lastAbility then the value "castTimeAbilityId" of lastAbility else the value "abilityId" of lastAbility.
  If v is the id of the move labelled "chaos_causings" on executer, then return the id of the move labelled "dimension_distortion" on executer.
  If v is the id of the move labelled "dimension_distortion" on executer, then return the id of the move labelled "chaotic_d" on executer.
Return a smart-weighted move of executer.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let v be call helper with (arg).
If v is the id of the move labelled "chaos_causings" on executer, then
  Let v2 be a random pick from list.
  Executer uses v with its cast time and then [{abilityId: v, abilityOptions: {skipAttackMotion: true, skipStepCnt: true}}, {abilityTag: v2}].
Otherwise, if v is the id of the move labelled "dimension_distortion" on executer, then executer uses v with its cast time and then [{abilityId: v, abilityOptions: {skipAttackMotion: true}}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}]]}}].
Otherwise, if v is the id of the move labelled "chaotic_d" on executer, then executer uses v with its cast time and then [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "02"}]]}}, {abilityId: v}].
Otherwise, executer uses v.
